propositions: Failed LLM calls do not write rows to the usage log because record() is called after the exception handler in run(), allowing exceptions from interpret_failure() to exit without logging
Usage log summaries under-report actual spend by omitting rows for failed calls, causing billable weekly CI job summaries to be incomplete and inaccurate
Per-step spend attribution added in change b690 cannot see failed calls, making it impossible to identify which expensive passes failed without reading stderr
A usage row for a failed call must include step, model_class, and outcome fields to be distinguishable from successful calls and enable proper spend accounting
The fix moves record_failure() into the except block before interpret_failure() re-raises, and adds an explicit outcome field to all rows to avoid double-counting retried calls
